== Question ==

The line:

''"She was murdered, along with Amico Nagoyin by Isam, who cut their throats and nailed their tongues to a door."''

I'm away from my books at this time, but the curiosity is killing me: were the tongues removed from the head prior to being nailed to the door? I just want to know the degree of "EWWWW" of the act.

--[[User:Sings-With-Spirits|Sings-With-Spirits]] ([[User talk:Sings-With-Spirits|talk]]) 15:06, December 6, 2012 (UTC)

: The book says that each had their throats rather messily cut, after their tongues had been nailed to the door. This Moiraine telling Egwene, Elayne, Nynaeve, and Aviendha. From the way that Moiraine is talking (calmly, as if talking about a dress), I would think that the "EWWWW" factor is pretty high and that the tongues were still attached to the women when they were nailed to the door. That's my two coppers. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 21:56, December 6, 2012 (UTC)

::Wait... so they had their tongues nailed to the door... ''THEN'' had their throats slit? Whoa.... Ewww Factor: 3.9 of 5. 

::--[[User:Sings-With-Spirits|Sings-With-Spirits]] ([[User talk:Sings-With-Spirits|talk]]) 22:13, December 6, 2012 (UTC)

::: ALmost certainly the tongues were not attached at the time, so I'd guess that bumps up the EWWW factor considerably. They were still alive when the tongues were being cut out and had to watch them being nailed up as a warning. == Discrepnancies ==

The page needs a note on the old editions that have Joiya as old enough to be their (Egwene and Nynaeve's) grandmother. It's mentioned in full on the page for [[Amico Nagoyin]]. This was changed in later printings (a lot later) so I'd guess it's worth noting as people still have old copies and can bbut them second-hand.
